question: After correcting q1/q2 target-entity construction, is the E2E-001 failure localized to learned persistent-state write addressing, learned read addressing, or lack of a coherent shared address interface?
hypothesis: Explicit structural entity addressing on the write path, read path, or both will localize the persistent-state failure without changing the multimodal representation, CASM, verifier, optimizer, held-out compositions, or seed schedule.

arms.name: explicit_write
arms.intervention: observation entity identity selects the persistent write slot; query read addressing remains learned

arms.name: explicit_read
arms.intervention: query entity identity selects the persistent read slot; observation write addressing remains learned

arms.name: explicit_both
arms.intervention: observation entity identity selects the persistent write slot and query entity identity selects the persistent read slot

endpoints.name: heldout_q2_accuracy_explicit_both
endpoints.description: Mean q2 accuracy over 400 corrected held-out episodes per seed with explicit write and explicit read addressing.

endpoints.name: heldout_q2_accuracy_explicit_write
endpoints.description: Mean q2 accuracy for the explicit-write/learned-read arm.

endpoints.name: heldout_q2_accuracy_explicit_read
endpoints.description: Mean q2 accuracy for the learned-write/explicit-read arm.

decision_rule.condition: benchmark-integrity and information-flow checks pass and explicit_both mean q2 accuracy >= 0.80 with every seed >= 0.40
decision_rule.licenses: the corrected synthetic address-intervention system meets the registered capability criterion
decision_rule.does_not_license: real-world multimodal capability, semantic addressing, arbitrary learned operators, or scaling

decision_rule.condition: explicit_both fails the primary criterion but all integrity checks pass
decision_rule.licenses: the explicit-both intervention does not meet the criterion; single-path diagnostics localize the failure without ranking arms

decision_rule.condition: explicit_write differs by at least 0.05 from explicit_read
decision_rule.licenses: evidence localizing the corrected benchmark failure toward one address path

decision_rule.condition: explicit_both differs by at least 0.05 from both single-path arms
decision_rule.licenses: evidence that write/read address coherence is consequential in this synthetic task

decision_rule.condition: q1/q2 entity identities overlap, held-out composition appears in TRAIN_COMBOS, or answer/outcome information enters before action

held_constant: q1 always targets entities[0] and q2 always targets entities[1]
same 12 complementary latent bits: text 0-3, image 4-7, audio 8-11
same eight held-out compositions as E2E-001, with strict training exclusion
same 300 training steps and 400 evaluation episodes per seed
E2E-001 and E2E-002 numeric outputs are provenance-only and are not used for tuning or baseline selection
all three arms use the same code and environment apart from the registered address intervention
controls use the same corrected held-out episodes as the explicit-both arm within each seed

invalid_history.e2e001: VOID benchmark generator: q1/q2 target-entity construction was incorrect
invalid_history.e2e002: VOID benchmark generator inherited the same defect

information_flow.pre_action: corrected text/image/audio observations -> encoders -> shared representation -> persistent write -> query-conditioned read -> CASM -> action
information_flow.post_action: environment outcome -> verifier -> differentiable verified write

scientific_boundaries: No real-world language, vision, or audio capability claim.
Explicit entity-address arms are structural controls, not evidence of learned semantic addressing.
Operator identity is public in this phase, so operator-selection accuracy is not interpreted as autonomous operator discovery.

statistics.provenance_rule: all three arm artifacts must report the same experiment head and merged checkout SHA before aggregation

amendments.old_definition: single-path or explicit-both differences were described as materially different without a registered numerical threshold
amendments.new_definition: diagnostic pairwise differences are material only when the absolute mean q2 difference is at least 0.05
amendments.rationale: A diagnostic decision rule must not introduce a post-hoc interpretation threshold through prose.
amendments.affected: diagnostic interpretation only; primary endpoint, benchmark, seeds and training schedule unchanged
amendments.no_result_under_previous_version: No E2E-003 measurement existed under the unquantified rule.

amendments.applies_to: explicit-both vs single-path diagnostic decision rule
amendments.old_definition: the explicit-both arm was described using an unquantified material-difference condition
amendments.new_definition: an explicit-both difference is diagnostic only when its mean q2 accuracy differs by at least 0.05 from each single-path arm
amendments.rationale: Prevent post-hoc prose from deciding what constitutes a meaningful arm difference.
amendments.discovered: Pre-measurement audit of the corrected contract.
amendments.affected: diagnostic interpretation only; primary endpoint and experimental parameters unchanged
amendments.no_result_under_previous_version: No E2E-003 measurement existed under the unquantified rule.
